# Amazon CloudWatch (`source_type: cloudwatch`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reads the latest datapoint of one CloudWatch metric with the agent host's AWS credentials.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: latest CloudWatch datapoint for the chosen statistic, in the metric's CloudWatch unit

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `region` | yes | string |  | up to 64 characters |
| `namespace` | yes | string |  | up to 255 characters |
| `metric_name` | yes | string |  | up to 255 characters |
| `dimensions` | no | object |  |  |
| `statistic` | no | string | `"Average"` | up to 16 characters |
| `period_seconds` | no | integer | `60` |  |
| `role_arn` | no | string |  | up to 2048 characters |
| `external_id` | no | string |  | up to 1224 characters |

## Rules

- `statistic` is Average, Sum, Minimum, Maximum, SampleCount, or a percentile such as p95 or p99.9.
- `period_seconds` is 60, 300, 900 or 3600.
- `role_arn` (and optional `external_id`) assumes a role from the host's credentials for cross-account reads.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: cloudwatch
source_config: {"region":"eu-west-1","namespace":"AWS/RDS","metric_name":"CPUUtilization","dimensions":{"DBInstanceIdentifier":"prod-db"},"statistic":"Average"}
```
